data.one_liner: CLI to install AI agent skills from your Dart/Flutter package dependencies.
data.what_it_does: The tool scans your project's dependency tree for packages that ship a skills/ directory and installs those Agent Skills into supported AI assistants. It can also add skills from Git repositories and manage installed skills (list, prune, remove).
use_when: You want AI coding assistants (e.g., Antigravity, Claude, Cursor) to understand how to use the packages in your project.
You ship Agent Skills with your own package and need a simple way for users to install them.
avoid_when: You are not using an AI agent that supports Agent Skills.
You need runtime functionality; this package only provides a CLI tool.
strengths: Automates discovery and installation of skills across all dependencies.
Supports multiple agents and Git‑based skill sources.
Integrates with pub get and works in monorepos.
weaknesses: Only works with agents that understand the Agent Skills spec.
Provides only a CLI; no programmatic API.
